title: Filing of Complaint after Specified Period

content.scenario: A consumer discovers a defect in a product after the specified period for filing a complaint has expired. The consumer approaches the District Commission, explaining that they had sufficient cause for not filing the complaint earlier.
content.outcome: The District Commission condones the delay and entertains the complaint, recording its reasons for doing so. The Commission may then proceed to hear the complaint and pass an order.

user_queries: What happens if a complaint is filed after the specified period?
How can a consumer show sufficient cause for not filing a complaint earlier?
Can the Commission condone a delay in filing a complaint?
